title: pilosella floribunda subsp. anomelana
intro: Pilosella floribunda subsp. anomelana, commonly known as Alpine Mouse Ear or Red Stem Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a perennial flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella floribunda subsp. anomelana are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
